system.description: Grimoire (400j). Requires: 5 minutes, 1 Spell Uses. Lasts: 30 seconds. A harmless illusory effect such as coloured sparks, a card trick or a glowing word. No one is impressed because you're reading it out of a book. Cast from a book: not usable in combat; Skimpy armour or none; if the caster joins combat the spell is interrupted.
